title: Cylinder head rebuild — valve job, guides, resurface

notices.text: Specify a three-angle valve job, new guides where clearance is out, new valve stem seals throughout, and a light resurface only if needed — remember the M96 head sits on a long-bolt stack, so material removed from the head changes the clamped stack height and interacts with head gasket thickness. Have the shop pressure-test both heads. Lap and vacuum-test each valve on return and photograph the seat contact rings.
